items.prompt: Why is a duplicate map insufficient to guarantee an external order is sent/executed exactly once across crashes?
items.modelAnswer: The send,remote acceptance/execution and durable processed marker are different boundaries. Crash/timeout can leave unknown outcome; need venue-supported identity/session/retry rules,atomic local state/marker protocol,retention/concurrency handling and independent reconciliation. A local pure replay map cannot certify the external side effect or grant trading authority.

criteria.text: Names crash/timeout unknown state and reconciliation.
Does not infer external exactly-once from projection deduplication.
